eyebrow.zh: 写代码之前 · 先说不做 · 纯 markdown
eyebrow.en: Before code · Say no first · Plain markdown

headline.zh:
让你的编码 agent
先说不做哪些
headline.en:
Make your coding agent
say what it won't do first

sub.zh: 计划先以一份「不予实现」清单开场——agent 把要做和不做的事都列出来，每条带一句理由，再把否决项摆出来等你拍板。纯 markdown，不锁平台。
sub.en: The plan opens as a will-not-implement list — your agent lays out what it will and won't do, each with a one-line reason, then surfaces the vetoes for your call. Plain markdown, no platform lock-in.

title.zh: 先开一份「不予实现」清单
title.en: It opens with a will-not-implement list

body.zh: 你让 agent 做功能 X，它默认还会搭上投机的基础设施、顺手的重构和「既然都到这了」的额外特性——而且代码还能编译，事后删起来很费劲。NegPlan 让它先列出要做和不做的事，每条带一句理由，把范围之争挪到写代码之前。
body.en: Ask an agent for feature X and it ships X plus speculative infrastructure, adjacent refactors, and "while I'm here" extras — and the code compiles, so pruning it is expensive. NegPlan makes it list what it will and won't do first, each with a one-line reason, moving the scope fight ahead of the code.

title.zh: 在写代码之前，你先拍板
title.en: You decide, before a line is written

body.zh: agent 把否决项逐条摆出来，问你留还是砍——你答完之前它不动手写代码。只有你放行的项才进入要做清单，范围由你说了算，不是 agent 拍脑袋。
body.en: The agent surfaces every veto, item by item, and asks keep or cut — and won't start coding until you've answered. Only what you allow moves into the plan. Scope is your call, not the agent's hunch.

title.zh: 每一处改动，都对得上清单
title.en: Every change ties back to the plan

body.zh: 当 agent 提出改动，每一处都要指明它满足清单里的哪一条。对不上号的改动被当作范围蔓延拦下、摆给你看，而不是默默写进去——代码更少，且都切题。
body.en: When the agent proposes a change, each one must point to a planned item it satisfies. Anything that doesn't match is held as scope creep and shown to you, not quietly written in — less code, and all of it on-topic.

body.zh: 整份计划就是一个 markdown 文件——你能读、能改、能存档，换一个 agent 接着用。没有常驻服务、没有云、没有账号、没有遥测。MIT 开源，永久免费。
body.en: The whole plan is one markdown file — you can read, edit, and archive it, and carry it to another agent. No daemon, no cloud, no account, no telemetry. MIT and free, for good.

headline.zh: 别再手动删 agent 写的投机代码了
headline.en: Stop pruning your agent's speculative code by hand

sub.zh: 让它先声明一份「不予实现」清单，把范围之争挪到写代码之前。开源、MIT、无付费墙、无遥测。
sub.en: Make it declare a will-not-implement list first, and move the scope fight ahead of the code. Open source, MIT, no paywall, no telemetry.

tag.zh: 一份让编码 agent 先说不做的「不予实现」清单
tag.en: The will-not-implement list that makes your coding agent say no first
